messages:
maria: Quick sync — landing copy pass for the three product pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private). I put a first draft in the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/landing-copy-drafts (please comment).
charlie: thanks — skimmed. felt the Hosted hero is too generic. can we lean into performance and predictable cost more?
kevin: +1. suggest hero: 'Predictable inference. Customizable deployment.' short and benefit-forward.
sasha: for Dedicated page we should lead with 'reserved throughput' and an SLA sentence. also need a short blurb about burst capacity.
maria: noted. i'm trying variant A/B examples for each hero. keeping CTAs consistent: "Get started" vs "Request capacity" vs "Contact sales". thoughts?
emma: for Private page the CTA should be "Request trial" not contact sales — legal asks for a lighter gate for PoC.
charlie: good call. also need a tiny FAQ block about KMS/HSM and VPC options. one-liners only.
kevin: inbound routing question — do we want Hosted signups to hit self-serve funnel, Dedicated to go to sales SDR, Private to go to enterprise AE?
sasha: yes. mapping: Hosted -> marketing leads (trial), Dedicated -> SDR queue (routing tag: product=dedicated), Private -> AE (enterprise). add UTM so we can A/B the hero messaging.
maria: sharing the routing template. please use this UTM format in launch posts and webinar CTAs:
```
?utm_source=launch_post&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch_2026&utm_content={page_variant}&product={mode}
```
emma: webinar planning — we have 3 slots. propose one webinar that covers serving runtime + one breakout focused on cost optimizations for each mode. short 30 min main, 20 min breakouts.
charlie: can we have a benchmark narrative to drive attendance? e.g., "How we cut inference cost by 3x with smart batching and KV caching" — concrete number helps.
kevin: agree. need a one-slide benchmark summary for the landing page with a small chart and a link to the full benchmark PDF. i'll make the slide.
sasha: launch posts — timeline: social teaser (M-7), benchmark highlights (M-3), webinar invite (M-1), day-of recap + CTA. social copy drafts in the doc.
maria: quick copy ask: give me 2 hero lines per page (concise) and 2 supporting bullets. i'll stitch variants for A/B testing.
emma: I can help with webinar sequence emails. we'll do 3-touch cadence: invite, reminder, day-of. include a specific CTA per mode that maps to routing rules.
kevin: for routing implementors: add a hidden field on form `product_mode` with values hosted/dedicated/private and parse in lead routing. example form snippet in the doc.
maria: small content decision — do we name models on the Hosted page or keep it neutral? marketing worried about gated expectations.
charlie: keep neutral, but add a "Verified performance" badge and link to benchmarks. preserves flexibility.
sasha: action items: Maria iterate hero variants by EOD tomorrow, Kevin produce benchmark slide by EOD today, Emma draft webinar emails by Friday, Charlie add FAQ one-liners, I (Sasha) will update inbound routing spec.
maria: thanks — tagging launch-bot to add calendar reminders and a merge window for the copy freeze.
launch-bot: Reminder set: copy-freeze window opens 2026-04-08 16:00 UTC. :spiral_calendar:
kevin: one tiny nit — please keep hero CTAs consistent visual weight across pages. if Dedicated uses "Request capacity" make it a primary button too.
emma: noted. i'll coordinate with design for button hierarchy.
maria: awesome team. I'll push an updated doc link when the variants are in: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/landing-copy-drafts (comment mode on). :thumbsup:
